title: Stryker completes acquisition of ZuriMED to enhance its shoulder offering
body_markdown:
---


**PORTAGE, Mich., USA – October 26, 2026** – Stryker (NYSE:SYK), a global leader in medical technologies, announced it has completed the acquisition of ZuriMED, a privately held company and developer of the FiberLocker® System.


The FiberLocker System is a commercialized rotator cuff augmentation technology designed to increase the biomechanical strength of the repair. The differentiated technology addresses an important clinical need in rotator cuff repair and expands Stryker’s ability to support shoulder surgeons with innovative solutions across the shoulder continuum of care.


“ZuriMED brings specialized expertise and a differentiated technology that complements our growing shoulder care capabilities,” said Andy Pierce, Group President, MedSurg and Neurotechnology, Stryker. “Together, we have an opportunity to advance the FiberLocker technology, expand access to innovative treatment options and deliver greater value for our customers and their patients.”


---


About Stryker


Stryker is a global leader in medical technologies and, together with our customers, we are driven to make healthcare better. We offer innovative products and services in MedSurg, Neurotechnology and Orthopaedics that help improve patient and healthcare outcomes. Alongside our customers around the world, we impact more than 150 million patients annually. More information is available at[www.stryker.com](https://www.stryker.com/us/en/index.html) .
